name: My Sweet Confession
source:
My Sweet Confession is an enchanting yuri visual novel about a school girl in love with her best friend...if only she knew how to show it! The hapless, love-struck Ichika made a mistake, a big one, and she might have ruined her friendship with Hana forever.

With the help of her classmate Ayumi, can she work her own feelings out in time to show Hana how she really feels? A soft, comedic romance with big personalities and a tinge of melodrama.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《我的甜蜜告白》是一部迷人的百合视觉小说，讲述了一个女学生爱上她最好的朋友的故事……如果她知道如何表达就好了！不幸的、陷入爱情的一花犯了一个错误，一个很大的错误，她可能永远毁掉了与花的友谊。

在同学步美的帮助下，她能否及时表达自己的感受，向哈娜展示她的真实感受？这是一部柔和的喜剧爱情片，个性鲜明，带有情节剧的色彩。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281140/]Steam[/url]]
